{{Top|leg}}
'''The Select''' were the seventeen highest acolytes of the [[Jeedai heresy|''Jeedai'' heresy]] as chosen by [[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]]. They were intelligent without being too bright, and loyal without being sycophants.
